تنتبهوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَبِهُوا (tantabihū) /tan.ta.bi.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# تُنْتَبَهُوا (tuntabahū) /tun.ta.ba.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
